items.name: i18n
items.title: NocoBase i18n
items.description: Optional NocoBase server-language resources, user preference persistence, reusable language controls, and an integrated showcase for the Starter's built-in i18n runtime.
items.docs: Requires a compatible NocoBase Starter with the built-in i18n provider, shared System Settings bootstrap, and AppExtension Provider/UserMenuItems host fields. The Registry reuses systemSettings:get data and calls app:getLang only for registered dynamic namespaces such as lm-collections.
